label: Partial ratios
subgoals: Truncate the stack at the layer being etched
Keep that layer's metal connected to the gate through lower layers
Divide its area by the gate area

label: Cumulative ratios
subgoals: Compute every layer's partial ratio up to the target layer
Exclude metal that was floating when its own layer was etched

label: The worst layer
subgoals: Compute the partial ratio of every layer
Compare each with its own layer limit
Report the layer with the largest ratio
